environment.description: Quarkus 3.2 serverless handler deployed on AWS Lambda behind API Gateway (HTTP API type, no additional route-level authorization). Environment variables set via SSM Parameter Store with standard retrieval. oauth.allowed.redirects=https://app.acme.com/callback. Client secret is static, stored in SSM as SecureString, loaded at cold start and cached for Lambda lifetime. No WAF or URL normalization layer in front of API Gateway.
